title: Crypto asset transactions with gift cards or debit cards

sections.heading: Transactions using gift or debit cards
sections.text:
You can use crypto assets in various ways, including transactions using gift cards or debit cards. This may include:

- using crypto assets to acquire a gift card
- loading or topping up a gift or debit card using crypto assets
- using a gift or debit card that is denominated in crypto assets.

If you acquire a gift card or debit card, which is then used to purchase items for personal use or consumption, you need to work out if your crypto asset qualifies as a personal use asset. For more information, see Crypto asset as a personal use asset.

sections.heading: Acquiring a gift card
sections.text:
A CGT event happens where you use crypto assets to acquire a gift card.

The CGT event happens irrespective of whether the gift card is denominated in Australian Dollars (AUD) or crypto assets. The capital proceeds for the CGT event equal the market value of the gift card when it is acquired.

sections.heading: Acquiring a gift card > Example: acquiring a gift card with crypto assets
sections.text:
Raj buys 50 ABC tokens for $50. Raj later uses these tokens to buy a $100 gift card.

A CGT event happens when Raj buys the gift card, as he disposes of 50 ABC tokens in exchange for the gift card.

Raj has a capital gain of $50.

End of example

sections.heading: Loading or topping up a gift or debit card
sections.text:
A CGT event happens when loading or topping up a gift or debit card using crypto assets.

For example, if you transfer crypto assets to the digital wallet of the gift or debit card provider for loading or topping up, this is a disposal of the crypto asset for CGT purposes. The proceeds for the CGT event equal the amount by which the available balance of the card is increased. That is, the value associated with loading or topping up of the card.

sections.heading: Loading or topping up a gift or debit card > Example: loading a debit card using crypto assets
sections.text:
Yindi has a debit card that is linked to her crypto wallet. Yindi uses her debit card to buy a television for $2,000.

The debit card provider draws crypto assets from Yindi's crypto wallet and converts them to AUD to pay to the merchant.

The capital proceeds for the disposal of crypto assets are $2,000.

End of example

sections.heading: Gift or debit cards denominated in crypto assets
sections.text: Where a gift or debit card is denominated in crypto assets, the AUD value of the available balance changes as the price of the crypto asset changes. In these circumstances, you must calculate if a capital gain or capital loss (or neither) results from transactions using the card.

sections.heading: Gift or debit cards denominated in crypto assets > Example: using a gift card denominated in crypto assets
sections.text:
Olivia has a gift card denominated in XRP (a type of crypto asset). Olivia paid 500 XRP to buy the gift card and it has an available balance of 500 XRP.

At the time Olivia bought the gift card, XRP had a market value of $1.

Olivia uses the gift card to buy a guitar costing 400 XRP.

At the time Olivia buys the guitar, XRP had a market value of $0.95. Olivia has a capital loss of $20 and a remaining balance of 100 XRP on the gift card.

End of example
